build_simple_redistribution_model: build a SimpleRedistribution model instance to redistribute plasma profiles after a sawtooth crash
apply_simple_redistribution_call: apply the SimpleRedistribution __call__ method to redistribute core plasma profiles given rho_norm_q1 and runtime params
build_runtime_params: build RuntimeParams for the simple redistribution model with a mixing_radius_multiplier value
build_simple_redistribution_config: build a SimpleRedistributionConfig Pydantic model to configure the simple sawtooth redistribution with mixing_radius_multiplier
flatten_density_profile: flatten the electron density profile inside the mixing radius using flatten_profile.flatten_density_profile
